statewideTerm: Missouri's only statewide race on November 3, 2026 was State Auditor, which Scott Fitzpatrick won; the other officers' terms run to January 2029. Eight House seats (29, 95, 99, 110, 114, 149, 159, 160) are listed as vacant on the House's own member list, November 17, 2026.

notes.election: A general election was held on November 3, 2026. This roster lists officials in office on the build date; people elected on November 3 take office in January 2027 and are not shown yet.
